================================================================================
simple string attribute
================================================================================

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  ami = "ami-12345678"
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (resource_block
    type: (string_lit)
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (quoted_template)))))))

================================================================================
nested block with label
================================================================================

resource "aws_security_group" "sg" {
  ingress "http" {
    from_port = 80
  }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (resource_block
    type: (string_lit)
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (block
        type: (identifier)

          (attribute
            name: (identifier)
            value: (expression
              (literal_value
                (numeric_lit)))))))))
